question: The largest population of the greater one-horned Rhino is found in _______ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The largest population of the greater **one-horned rhinoceros (Rhinoceros unicornis)** is found in the state of **Assam in India**.
 
• Assam is home to **Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site**, which hosts the majority of the world's greater one-horned rhinos.
 
• Besides Kaziranga, the greater one-horned rhino can also be found in other protected areas in Assam, such as **Manas National Park and Nameri National Park**.
 
• Due to successful conservation measures, the population of greater one-horned rhinos in Kaziranga has significantly increased over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala** is known for its rich biodiversity, with numerous wildlife sanctuaries and national parks, such as **Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary and Silent Valley National Park.**
 
• Kerala is a paradise for bird watchers, with over 500 species of birds, including migratory species. The **Vembanad Lake and Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary** are notable spots for birdwatching.
 
• **Sikkim** is home to several endangered species, including the **Red Panda and the Snow Leopard.**
 
• Tamil Nadu boasts several wildlife sanctuaries and national parks, including **Mudumalai National Park, Anamalai Tiger Reserve, and Indira Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary.**
 
• The **Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary** is famous for its large populations of migratory waterfowl.
